sloka: अथवा ऽ ऽदाय रक्षांसि न्यसेयुः संवृते हि माम् ।यत्र ते नाभिजानीयुर्हरयो नापि राघवौ ।आरम्भस्तु मदर्थो ऽयं ततस्तव निरर्थकः ।। ५.३७.५६।।।।
transliteration: athavā ' 'dāya rakṣāṁsi nyaseyuḥ saṁvṛte hi mām ।yatra te nābhijānīyurharayo nāpi rāghavau ।ārambhastu madartho 'yaṁ tatastava nirarthakaḥ ।। 5.37.56।।।।

translations.english: "It may be that you can kill all the demons but by such an act the fame of Rama will be diminished. (He cannot give his strength a trial)
